prompts.text:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: wide background plate for a 1920x1080 Chinese explainer animation, scene about communication noise
Primary request: an abstract communication journey, a small luminous signal traveling through a calm channel between two distant abstract endpoints, with faint interference in the surrounding space
Style/medium: premium editorial science illustration, dimensional but clean, restrained and polished
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, broad negative space across the center for precise vector labels and diagrams to be composited later; keep bright detail away from the lower subtitle area
Lighting/mood: calm, thoughtful, cinematic low-key lighting
Color palette: deep navy, teal and a small warm coral accent
Constraints: background plate only, no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, or readable symbols; no human faces; do not depict a specific real device

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: wide background plate for a 1920x1080 Chinese explainer animation, scene showing a signal disrupted by noise
Primary request: an abstract luminous waveform crossing a dark communication channel and meeting scattered interference particles; show a clear but non-alarming disruption while the path remains visible
Style/medium: premium editorial science illustration, clean dimensional 2D/3D hybrid
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, keep the central horizontal band low-contrast and open for a precise vector flow diagram overlay; keep the bottom quarter dark for subtitles
Lighting/mood: focused, explanatory, not dramatic or threatening
Color palette: deep navy, cool teal and restrained amber/coral
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, or embedded diagram; no claims that every signal fails

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: wide background plate for a 1920x1080 Chinese explainer animation, introductory scene about batch processing and stream processing
Primary request: a visual metaphor with one side showing a neat group of information cards waiting together and the other side showing a steady flow of individual glowing data particles, balanced as two distinct but related modes
Style/medium: polished editorial technology illustration, tactile paper and light, sophisticated and uncluttered
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, balanced left and right halves with open middle and lower area for vector titles and captions; dark quiet background
Lighting/mood: clear, calm, analytical
Color palette: deep indigo, teal, muted blue and small warm orange highlights
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, or fake chart; do not imply either method is universally faster

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: wide background plate for a 1920x1080 Chinese explainer animation, comparison scene for batch versus stream processing
Primary request: an editorial visual comparison: on one side, several records collected into a single organized tray before moving; on the other, records moving one by one along a continuous illuminated path
Style/medium: refined science magazine illustration, clear forms, subtle depth, restrained detail
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, two broad visual zones left and right, enough low-detail space for exact vector comparison cards to overlay; keep center open
Lighting/mood: balanced and informative, no action-movie drama
Color palette: dark navy foundation, teal flow, muted blue, small amber accent
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, arrows with symbols, or embedded data; do not state a performance winner

Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: wide background plate behind a programmatically rendered zero-baseline bar chart in a Chinese explainer
Primary request: quiet abstract data atmosphere with faint illuminated grid depth and a few soft geometric particles framing the edges
Style/medium: polished editorial data visualization background, subtle material texture, minimal and low contrast
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, central two thirds very dark and nearly empty so accurate vector bars, labels, and numbers remain dominant; keep the bottom subtitle band clear
Lighting/mood: composed, precise and trustworthy
Color palette: deep navy, muted teal and faint blue, no bright focal object
Constraints: background only; no bars, chart, axes, numbers, letters, text, logos, watermark, UI, or implied data

Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: wide background plate for the opening/closing scene of a Chinese explainer about illustrative values
Primary request: abstract geometric tokens arranged in three quiet clusters with subtle depth, suggesting categories without encoding quantities
Style/medium: premium editorial data illustration, minimal and trustworthy
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, low-contrast edges and broad clear center for exact vector labels and programmatic chart; dark clean lower band for subtitles
Lighting/mood: neutral and explanatory
Color palette: deep navy, muted blue, teal and a tiny amber accent
Constraints: do not depict bars or a chart; no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, watermark, or UI; do not visually imply any specific value or ranking
